about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.

## DEMOCRAT
U.S. Congress, Maryland
7th Congressional District
## ELECTION
NOVEMBER 8, 2022
## EARLY
OCT 27 – NOV 3, 2022
## On Maryland’s 7th Congressional District Election:
Where is Maryland’s 7th Congressional District?
Maryland’s 7th Congressional District covers most of the City of Baltimore and broad portions of western and eastern Baltimore County.
When does Early Voting open and close?
Early voting begins on Thursday, October 27th and ends on Thursday, November 3rd, 2022
Where's the Early Voting location nearest me?
Find the early voting location nearest you at: https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2022/2022_Early%20Voting_Centers.pdf
What is the deadline to submit Mail-in Ballots?
If you are a Maryland voter, click here to learn more about requesting a mail-in ballot and voting by mail.
The deadline to receive your request for a ballot using the online system or by mail is November 1, 2022 for the Gubernatorial General Election. For a list of designated ballot drop boxes: https://elections.maryland.gov/voting/documents/2022_GG_DropBoxLocations_English.pdf
What is the date for the General Election for Maryland?
General Election Day is Tuesday, November 8, 2022. Find your assigned voting location at: https://voterservices.elections.maryland.gov/PollingPlaceSearch
